name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceAppInfoStyle3Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an advertised app uses the third download-confirmation design. It shows the app details and download action together with the ad's follow-up page.
disableEffect: The third style of voice-read app-install page will no longer open.
